name: io.github.mspstack/mcp-connectwise-psa
title: ConnectWise PSA
description: ConnectWise PSA (Manage) MCP server — tickets, time entries, companies, configurations, BYOK

environmentVariables.name: CW_SITE
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise host (e.g. na.myconnectwise.net or an on-prem host; full URLs accepted)

environmentVariables.name: CW_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER
environmentVariables.description: Member identifier the API keys belong to — enables "my tickets"/"my time" tools

environmentVariables.name: CW_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of toolsets/presets (default: all). Add sql for database queries.

environmentVariables.name: CW_DB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise SQL Server host (on-prem only) — enables the opt-in sql toolset

environmentVariables.name: CW_DB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the read-only database login

environmentVariables.name: CW_DB_QUERY_LIBRARY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a writable JSON file holding saved SQL queries
